notes.title: I completely re-created Myth of Mirka with DALLE-2 OpenAI images!
notes.notes:
After a lot of feedback from players, I decided to re-create Myth of Mirka from the ground up with a much more realistic (and animated) book, twice as much storyline, computer-generated AI images from DALLE-2, and brand-new music!
